principle: docs/OPENTALLAS_REDESIGN_PLAN.md gate G3: a provisional budget that is wrong and fails loudly is worth more than a correct one that cannot fail. These budgets are the analytical model's own batch-1 per-user step time for the design point the chip is derived from, widened by a stated tolerance. They are allowed to be wrong. They are not allowed to be absent.

tolerance_note: A measured TPOT within 1.5x of the analytical step passes. The band covers the residuals results/derived/qwen3_n5_design_target_reconciliation.json attributes and does not cover a regime change: a run that is compute-bound where the model is weight-read-bound fails C3 regardless of this band.

measurement_contract.rule: tpot_s is architectural: token-commit ticks over the admitted target timebase on a run whose exact execution identity first passed the correct-token gate (G1). correctness_qualified must be true and token_record must name the passing record. Host wall time, functional-simulator wall time and roofline figures are refused.
